zh: 结果里每种字母恰好保留一次，并保持原有相对顺序；要让字典序最大，越靠前的位置越希望放大的字母。
用单调栈：遇到较大的字母时，如果栈顶字母比它小、而且后面还会再出现，就把栈顶弹掉，以后再补回来。
先统计每个字母剩余出现次数；扫描时剩余次数减一，若该字母已在栈中就跳过；否则当栈顶 < 当前字母且栈顶剩余次数 >0 时不断弹栈并取消“在栈中”标记，再压入当前字母；最后栈内容即答案。
en: Each letter is kept exactly once in the result, in its original relative order; to maximize the result lexicographically, earlier positions should hold larger letters.
Use a monotonic stack: when a larger letter arrives and the top of the stack is smaller and will appear again later, pop the top and pick it up again later.

First count the remaining occurrences of each letter; while scanning, decrement the current letter's count and skip it if it is already on the stack; otherwise, while the top is smaller than the current letter and still has remaining occurrences, pop it and clear its on-stack flag, then push the current letter; the stack is the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

When a larger letter arrives, a monotonic stack pops smaller letters that will still appear later.

## Proof of correctness

A popped letter has a later copy that can take its place; moving the current larger letter forward raises the result lexicographically; letters that cannot be replaced later are kept.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(σ) space.
